posts.title: Using the VSCode Claude Code Extension with Bedrock and Claude Sonnet 4.5
posts.description: Lots of folks use the Claude IDE, or the Claude Code VSCode extension. Unfortunately, your prompts and completions are used (by default) to train Claude models. [0] AWS Bedrock, on the other hand, doesn’t use your prompts and completions to train any AWS models or give them to 3rd parties. posts.title: Firecracker Virtualization Overview
posts.description: Firecracker is an open source virtualization technology created by Amazon Web Services (AWS) which underpins their AWS Lambda Functions as a Service (FaaS) serverless product. Firecracker was open sourced in 2018 [0] , making it possible for anyone to use this extremely fast and reliable system for their own projects and use cases.
